We're getting close to our renewal window for Acuity's contract with Redwood (current term ends 2025-09-30). Procurement asked me to reboard on your portal so they can submit a PO and run the standard vendor checks. Can you share next steps and a short checklist so we can kick this over to procurement? Happy to schedule a 30-min handoff if helpful.
